inclusions.text: Five nights in carefully selected five-star hotels
inclusions.source: Five nights in carefully selected five-star hotels, three nights aboard a five-star cruise vessel with onboard pool, spa, and entertainment, one overnight train journey (Cairo to Aswan, with dinner onboard), a Luxor–Cairo domestic flight, a traditional felucca sail at Aswan, a farewell Nile dinner cruise in Cairo, private air-conditioned transfers throughout, a licensed English-speaking Egyptologist at every site, and full board — these are the operating mechanics.

inclusions.text: Airport meeting and transfer to hotel on arrival
inclusions.source: You are met at Cairo International Airport and transferred to your hotel.

inclusions.text: Lunch and dinner on day one
inclusions.source: Lunch and dinner are provided, and the schedule asks nothing more.

inclusions.text: Transfer to Cairo International Airport on departure
inclusions.source: Day ten is the departure: a final breakfast and the transfer to Cairo International Airport, with later flights giving room for additional arrangements so the last hours in Egypt are not spent in a terminal.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.source: You are met at Cairo International Airport and transferred to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Giza pyramids, Sphinx and Egyptian Museum
itinerary.source: The night is spent again at your Cairo hotel.

itinerary.title: Citadel, Khan el-Khalili, overnight train
itinerary.source: In the evening you board the overnight train to Aswan, with dinner served onboard.

itinerary.title: High Dam, Unfinished Obelisk, Philae Temple
itinerary.source: Tonight is spent in a hotel in Aswan; the cruise boards tomorrow morning.

itinerary.title: Board your Nile cruise
itinerary.source: The cruise will carry you for three nights; this first afternoon is for settling into it.

itinerary.title: Kom Ombo and Edfu
itinerary.source: Dinner is taken onboard as the cruise continues toward Luxor.

itinerary.title: Luxor East Bank: Karnak, Luxor Temple
itinerary.source: In the evening there is free time aboard the cruise or in the town, with the West Bank's limestone cliffs going gold across the water at dusk.

itinerary.title: West Bank, flight back to Cairo
itinerary.source: In the afternoon you disembark and transfer to Luxor Airport for the short domestic flight back to Cairo, where your driver meets you and takes you to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Memphis, Saqqara, Dahshur and dinner cruise
itinerary.source: The night is spent at your Cairo hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.source: Day ten is the departure: a final breakfast and the transfer to Cairo International Airport, with later flights giving room for additional arrangements so the last hours in Egypt are not spent in a terminal.
